entries.summary: Sukanya Jana et al. — We investigate the quantum dynamics of a single ion confined in a radio-frequency (RF) Paul trap in the presence of weak octupole-induced anharmonicity, as can occur in realistic ion-trap potential. The explicitly time-dependent quadrupole potential is…

entries.title: Impact of ab initio E1 strength on neutron capture rates along the nickel isotopic chain
entries.summary: Francesca Bonaiti et al. — Nucleosynthesis simulations of the r-process require neutron capture rates for neutron-rich nuclei, many of which lie beyond experimental reach. Predicting these rates relies on theoretical calculations of the low-energy electric dipole (E1) strength…

entries.title: Quantum 'birthmarks' hold lasting traces of a system's past
entries.summary: Some classical physical systems can explore many configurations over time until their long-term behavior no longer reveals their starting conditions. The sampling of available configurations according to the appropriate statistical distribution is a property called ergodicity.
